title: Assessing and Improving the Representativeness of Code Generation Benchmarks Using Knowledge Units (KUs) of Programming Languages – An Empirical Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the representativeness and distributive fairness of code generation benchmarks by calculating the coverage and distributional balance of programming language Knowledge Units (KUs) compared to real-world codebases using Lorenz curves, the Gini index, and Jensen-Shannon Distance.
